question: When I learn from Academic Dispute, can I choose to do nothing?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: both parts of learn are optional, so you may do nothing.
expected.answer: If instructed to learn, you may do nothing. Discarding a card and putting a Lesson card into your hand are both optional.
